checks.name: c) integration

objective:
Discover new mechanisms in which TRAINING-ONLY user behaviour and HYPERBOLIC geometry are computationally coupled to improve the RQ-VAE Semantic IDs used by a generative next-item recommender, with the real target of Stage3 test Recall@10 above 0.065.

## The measured target

Across 67 SID tables paired with their Stage 3 recall, the strongest measured predictor of
`test_recall@10` is **co-occurrence coherence inside the three-token prefix**
(`cooccur_overlap_L3`: the mean cosine similarity of the training co-consumption rows of
item pairs that share a three-token prefix): Spearman **0.902** [0.831, 0.939], and its
shape is non-linear and saturating — out-of-sample R² 0.67 for an isotonic fit against
0.51 for a straight line, with a step at 0.062 worth +0.0123 recall (permutation
p = 0.0005). Second and third are `adjacency_L1` (0.84) and the held-out prefix
discrimination `er_L1` (0.78). Purity is excluded: it can be raised by collapsing a level
(measured: purity 0.494 with adjacency 0.000 and recall below the baseline).

## The mechanism this round implements

Optimise that target directly in Stage 2. For every minibatch, three factors are combined:

1. `S_ij`, the **fixed** cosine similarity of the train-only co-occurrence rows of items i
   and j (detached; the behaviour signal);
2. `J_ij = (p1_i·p1_j)(p2_i·p2_j)(p3_i·p3_j)`, the probability that the two items share all
   three codes, computed from the model's **differentiable soft assignment** at each level
   under the curved distance;
3. the loss `-mean_ij S_ij J_ij` over the off-diagonal pairs of the minibatch.

Maximising it pushes coherent pairs into the same prefix; the quantisation and
reconstruction losses stay untouched, so the codebook still has to reconstruct.

## Requirements

* the behaviour signal must be train-only co-occurrence, computed once before training and
  frozen;
* the soft assignment must be the model's own, at all three levels, so the gradient reaches
  the encoder and the three codebooks;
* the term must be scale-matched (its value is O(0.05) against a reconstruction loss of
  ~1e-4) and must stay sparse per step (a dense 1024-row block costs 19 s/epoch);
* behaviour-off must shuffle the co-occurrence rows' item association, geometry-off must
  replace the curved distance with the Euclidean one.

## Required measurement contract

Report `L1 Hard ER`, `cooccur_overlap_L3` (the target itself, on the exported SID),
`adjacency_L1`, gold-prefix survival at depths 1-4, the extension-token alphabet, and Stage 3
`test_R@10`. The baseline control is 0.055537 and the target is 0.065.

## Frozen constraints

Four tokens, 3000 Stage 2 epochs on four cards, no early stopping, no test-time tuning, the
frozen Stage 3 protocol, no validation or test behaviour anywhere in the SID construction.

No call path from this trainer reaches `poincare_distance`, `expmap0`, or another curved operation.
